name: Stella: into the Shadow
source:
Welcome to Blackwood—a small provincial town that holds more secrets than it seems at first glance.

Stella’s life has long turned into a series of predictable and routine days, but suddenly, the usual order of things breaks.

One missing friend. One text message. One step into the shadow that will change everything.

To uncover the truth, Stella will have to take extreme measures: get a job at a nightclub full of secrets, mysteries, and dangerous connections. Every little detail could be the key to solving the puzzle or the cause of failure.

But this path is not just about finding her missing friend. For Stella, it becomes a journey of self-discovery. She will have to face her fears and question everything: her values, her relationships, and even the closest people around her.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3552560/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到布莱克伍德——这座省级小镇蕴藏着比乍一看更多的秘密。

斯特拉的生活早已变成了一系列可预测的、例行公事的日子，但突然间，平常的秩序被打破了。

一位失踪的朋友。一条短信。踏入阴影将改变一切。

为了揭开真相，斯特拉必须采取极端措施：在一家充满秘密、神秘和危险关系的夜总会找到一份工作。每一个小细节都可能是解决难题的关键或失败的原因。

但这条路不仅仅是为了寻找她失踪的朋友。对于斯特拉来说，这变成了一次自我发现的旅程。她将不得不面对自己的恐惧并质疑一切：她的价值观、她的人际关系，甚至她周围最亲密的人。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3552560/]Steam[/url]]
